filter_images_laplacian: filter a list of image paths by sharpness using the Laplacian variance threshold
calculate_image_sharpness: calculate the sharpness score of an image using the Laplacian variance method
convert_to_corners: convert 3D bounding boxes with center and dimensions to their eight corner coordinates
calculate_iou_3d: calculate the 3D Intersection over Union of two axis-aligned bounding boxes
project_mask_to_3d: project a 2D mask to 3D world coordinates using depth and camera matrices
